Śiromaṇi
a title given to Raghunātha Śiromaṇi Bhaṭṭācārya or Tārkika Śiromaṇi or usually Śiromaṇi (15th C.E.). He was a disciple of Vāsudeva Sārvabhauma an. father of Rāmakṛṣṇa of Mithilā.
-Ākhyātavāda or ºśaktivāda or ºvādārtha or ºviveka. See under Ākhyātavāda an. also under Ragunāthaśiromaṇi.
Addl. mss.: VSM. Poona V. 294. 433.
-C. on Tiṅantaśiromaṇi. gr. Mysore 4.
-Nañārthavāda or Nañvāda. See under Raghunātha Śiromaṇi.
Addl. mss.: VSM. Poona V. 349-50.
-C. on Padārthatattvanirūpaṇa or Padārthakhaṇḍana.
Addl. ms.: VSM. Poona V. 367.
-Sarvadarśanaśiromaṇi. L. 1847.
For his other works see under Raghunātha Śiromaṇi.
